The two 2023 revenue figures are not comparable because the 2023 amount in the 2024 Form 10-K has been restated to exclude the Solventum (Health Care) business as discontinued operations, while the standalone 2023 Form 10-K figure includes that business. [DOC-3] explains that “the historical results of Solventum are reported … as discontinued operations for all periods presented” in the 2024 filing, which changes the basis of presentation versus the original 2023 Form 10-K. Therefore, to measure growth from 2023 to 2024 on a consistent basis, the 2023 revenue figure from the 2024 Form 10-K ($24,610 million) must be compared to the 2024 revenue figure from the same statement ($24,575 million), not to the originally reported 2023 total revenue of $32,681 million.

Supporting excerpts:

- 2023 total revenue per original 2023 Form 10-K: “Total revenue for fiscal year 2023: $32,681 million.” [DOC-1]  
- 2024 Form 10-K income statement: “Total revenue for fiscal year 2024: $24,575 million. Total revenue for fiscal year 2023 (as presented for comparative purposes in this filing): $24,610 million.” [DOC-2]  
- Basis change due to spin-off: “On April 1, 2024, 3M completed the … separation of its Health Care business… The historical results of Solventum are reported in 3M's consolidated financial statements as discontinued operations for all periods presented.” [DOC-3]

Using the comparable basis (as restated in the 2024 Form 10-K):

- 2023 revenue (restated, continuing ops basis): $24,610 million [DOC-2]  
- 2024 revenue: $24,575 million [DOC-2]

Revenue growth rate from 2023 to 2024 (restated basis):

\[
\text{Growth} = \frac{24{,}575 - 24{,}610}{24{,}610} = \frac{-35}{24{,}610} \approx -0.14\%
\]

So on a comparable (post-spin, continuing-operations) basis, 3M’s revenue declined by about 0.14% from 2023 to 2024.

ANSWER: -0.14% (a 0.14% decline in revenue from FY 2023 to FY 2024 on a comparable basis)
